==== 4835 src/kits/pixelstory/environment/albedo.ts
// Albedo buffers: a set is painted once as material + value (+ facing, + emission),
// then relit every frame. This separates "what the thing is" from "how it is lit",
// so a light that moves through the room really changes the room.

import { RAMPS, type RampName } from "../core/palette.ts";
import { hash2 } from "../core/noise.ts";

export const MATERIALS = Object.keys(RAMPS) as RampName[];
const MAT_INDEX = Object.fromEntries(MATERIALS.map((m, i) => [m, i + 1])) as Record<RampName, number>;

export type Albedo = {
  w: number;
  h: number;
  /** Offset of the buffer's (0,0) in set coordinates (lets layers extend off-screen). */
  ox: number;
  oy: number;
  mat: Uint8Array;
  val: Float32Array;
  emit: Float32Array;
  /** Surface facing: -1..1 per axis. (0,0) faces the camera and takes light from any side. */
  nx: Int8Array;
  ny: Int8Array;
};

export const createAlbedo = (w: number, h: number, ox = 0, oy = 0): Albedo => ({
  w,
  h,
  ox,
  oy,
  mat: new Uint8Array(w * h),
  val: new Float32Array(w * h),
  emit: new Float32Array(w * h),
  nx: new Int8Array(w * h),
  ny: new Int8Array(w * h),
});

export type PaintOpts = { val?: number; emit?: number; nx?: number; ny?: number; jitter?: number; seed?: number };

/** Painter in set coordinates. All shapes clip to the buffer. */
export const painter = (a: Albedo) => {
  const put = (sx: number, sy: number, m: RampName, o: PaintOpts = {}) => {
    const x = Math.round(sx) - a.ox;
    const y = Math.round(sy) - a.oy;
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= a.w || y >= a.h) return;
    const i = y * a.w + x;
    const j = o.jitter ? (hash2(x * 7 + (o.seed ?? 0), y * 13) - 0.5) * o.jitter : 0;
    a.mat[i] = MAT_INDEX[m];
    a.val[i] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.2, (o.val ?? 0.6) + j));
    a.emit[i] = o.emit ?? 0;
    a.nx[i] = o.nx ?? 0;
    a.ny[i] = o.ny ?? 0;
  };
  const rect = (x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, m: RampName, o: PaintOpts = {}) => {
    for (let yy = 0; yy < h; yy++) for (let xx = 0; xx < w; xx++) put(x + xx, y + yy, m, o);
  };
  const hline = (x: number, y: number, w: number, m: RampName, o: PaintOpts = {}) => rect(x, y, w, 1, m, o);
  const vline = (x: number, y: number, h: number, m: RampName, o: PaintOpts = {}) => rect(x, y, 1, h, m, o);
  const disc = (cx: number, cy: number, r: number, m: RampName, o: PaintOpts = {}) => {
    for (let y = Math.floor(cy - r); y <= Math.ceil(cy + r); y++)
      for (let x = Math.floor(cx - r); x <= Math.ceil(cx + r); x++)
        if ((x - cx) ** 2 + (y - cy) ** 2 <= r * r) put(x, y, m, o);
  };
  const ring = (cx: number, cy: number, r: number, m: RampName, o: PaintOpts = {}) => {
    for (let y = Math.floor(cy - r - 1); y <= Math.ceil(cy + r + 1); y++)
      for (let x = Math.floor(cx - r - 1); x <= Math.ceil(cx + r + 1); x++) {
        const d = Math.sqrt((x - cx) ** 2 + (y - cy) ** 2);
        if (Math.abs(d - r) < 0.55) put(x, y, m, o);
      }
  };
  /** Bresenham line. */
  const line = (x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number, m: RampName, o: PaintOpts = {}) => {
    let x = Math.round(x0);
    let y = Math.round(y0);
    const X = Math.round(x1);
    const Y = Math.round(y1);
    const dx = Math.abs(X - x);
    const dy = -Math.abs(Y - y);
    const sx = x < X ? 1 : -1;
    const sy = y < Y ? 1 : -1;
    let err = dx + dy;
    for (;;) {
      put(x, y, m, o);
      if (x === X && y === Y) break;
      const e2 = 2 * err;
      if (e2 >= dy) {
        err += dy;
        x += sx;
      }
      if (e2 <= dx) {
        err += dx;
        y += sy;
      }
    }
  };
  /** Polygon fill (even-odd scanline), points in set coordinates. */
  const poly = (pts: [number, number][], m: RampName, o: PaintOpts = {}) => {
    const ys = pts.map((p) => p[1]);
    for (let y = Math.floor(Math.min(...ys)); y <= Math.ceil(Math.max(...ys)); y++) {
      const xs: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
        const [x0, y0] = pts[i];
        const [x1, y1] = pts[(i + 1) % pts.length];
        if ((y0 <= y + 0.5 && y1 > y + 0.5) || (y1 <= y + 0.5 && y0 > y + 0.5))
          xs.push(x0 + ((y + 0.5 - y0) / (y1 - y0)) * (x1 - x0));
      }
      xs.sort((p, q) => p - q);
      for (let k = 0; k + 1 < xs.length; k += 2)
        for (let x = Math.round(xs[k]); x < Math.round(xs[k + 1]); x++) put(x, y, m, o);
    }
  };
  /** Darken (multiply value) — for painted contact shadows and ambient occlusion. */
  const shade = (x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, k: number) => {
    for (let yy = 0; yy < h; yy++)
      for (let xx = 0; xx < w; xx++) {
        const px = Math.round(x + xx) - a.ox;
        const py = Math.round(y + yy) - a.oy;
        if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= a.w || py >= a.h) continue;
        a.val[py * a.w + px] *= k;
      }
  };
  return { put, rect, hline, vline, disc, ring, line, poly, shade };
};

==== 14068 src/kits/pixelstory/environment/props.ts
// Reusable set pieces, painted into albedo buffers. Each prop takes a painter and a
// seed so a new set can reuse the vocabulary without repeating the exact layout.
// Values (val) describe material lightness; the scene's lights decide the final colour.

import type { RampName } from "../core/palette";
import { hash2, rng } from "../core/noise";
import type { painter as Painter } from "./albedo";

type P = ReturnType<typeof Painter>;

/** Vertical board wall with seams, grain, staggered joints and the odd knot. */
export const plankWall = (
  p: P,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  w: number,
  h: number,
  o: { board?: number; mat?: RampName; base?: number; seed?: number } = {},
) => {
  const board = o.board ?? 7;
  const mat = o.mat ?? "wood";
  const base = o.base ?? 0.5;
  const r = rng(o.seed ?? 3);
  for (let bx = x, i = 0; bx < x + w; bx += board, i++) {
    const v = base + (r() - 0.5) * 0.14;
    const joint = y + Math.floor(r() * h);
    const knotY = y + Math.floor(r() * h);
    const hasKnot = r() < 0.35;
    const grain = [1 + Math.floor(r() * (board - 2)), 1 + Math.floor(r() * (board - 2))];
    for (let yy = y; yy < y + h; yy++) {
      for (let xx = 0; xx < board && bx + xx < x + w; xx++) {
        let val = v;
        if (xx === 0) val *= 0.32; // seam
        else if (xx === 1) val *= 1.12; // edge catching light
        if (grain.includes(xx)) val *= 0.86 + 0.08 * Math.sin(yy * 0.21 + i);
        if (yy === joint) val *= 0.4;
        if (hasKnot && Math.abs(yy - knotY) <= 1 && Math.abs(xx - board / 2) <= 1) val *= 0.62;
        p.put(bx + xx, yy, mat, { val, jitter: 0.05, seed: i });
      }
    }
  }
};

/** Heavy horizontal beam: top face, body, underside that catches light from below. */
export const beam = (p: P, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, seed = 5) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  p.rect(x, y, w, h, "woodDark", { val: 0.5, jitter: 0.08, seed });
  for (let yy = y + 2; yy < y + h - 2; yy += 2 + Math.floor(r() * 2))
    for (let xx = x; xx < x + w; xx++) if (hash2(xx, yy) > 0.55) p.put(xx, yy, "woodDark", { val: 0.42 });
  p.hline(x, y, w, "woodDark", { val: 0.36, ny: -1 });
  p.hline(x, y + h - 1, w, "woodDark", { val: 0.85, ny: 1 });
  p.hline(x, y + h - 2, w, "woodDark", { val: 0.62, ny: 1 });
  for (let bx = x + 9; bx < x + w; bx += 26) {
    p.rect(bx, y + 3, 2, 2, "metal", { val: 0.7 });
    p.put(bx + 1, y + 4, "metal", { val: 0.35 });
  }
};

export const post = (p: P, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number) => {
  p.rect(x, y, w, h, "woodDark", { val: 0.5, jitter: 0.08, seed: x });
  p.vline(x, y, h, "woodDark", { val: 0.3 });
  p.vline(x + w - 1, y, h, "woodDark", { val: 0.75, nx: 1 });
};

/** Diagonal knee brace from (x0,y0) to (x1,y1). */
export const brace = (p: P, x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number, t = 3) => {
  p.poly(
    [
      [x0, y0],
      [x0 + t, y0],
      [x1 + t, y1],
      [x1, y1],
    ],
    "woodDark",
    { val: 0.48, jitter: 0.06 },
  );
  p.line(x0, y0 + 1, x1, y1 + 1, "woodDark", { val: 0.75, ny: 1 });
};

/** Night window: frame, mullions, sky with stars, a crescent moon, a distant town. */
export const nightWindow = (p: P, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, seed = 11) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  p.rect(x, y, w, h, "woodDark", { val: 0.5 });
  const ix = x + 3;
  const iy = y + 3;
  const iw = w - 6;
  const ih = h - 6;
  for (let yy = 0; yy < ih; yy++)
    p.rect(ix, iy + yy, iw, 1, "sky", { val: 0.35, emit: 0.08 + (yy / ih) * 0.14 });
  for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) {
    const sx = ix + Math.floor(r() * iw);
    const sy = iy + Math.floor(r() * ih * 0.6);
    p.put(sx, sy, "ivoryLit", { val: 0.2, emit: 0.35 + r() * 0.35 });
  }
  // crescent moon
  const mx = ix + iw * 0.72;
  const my = iy + ih * 0.22;
  p.disc(mx, my, 3.6, "paper", { val: 0.4, emit: 0.92 });
  p.disc(mx - 1.6, my - 1, 3.2, "sky", { val: 0.35, emit: 0.1 });
  // distant rooftops with a few lit windows
  let cx = ix;
  while (cx < ix + iw) {
    const bw = 3 + Math.floor(r() * 5);
    const bh = 4 + Math.floor(r() * 9);
    p.rect(cx, iy + ih - bh, bw, bh, "sky", { val: 0.25, emit: 0.03 });
    for (let k = 0; k < bw * bh * 0.05; k++)
      p.put(cx + Math.floor(r() * bw), iy + ih - bh + 1 + Math.floor(r() * (bh - 1)), "amberLamp", { val: 0.2, emit: 0.32 + r() * 0.22 });
    cx += bw;
  }
  // mullions
  p.rect(x + Math.floor(w / 2) - 1, y, 2, h, "woodDark", { val: 0.55 });
  p.rect(x, y + Math.floor(h * 0.45), w, 2, "woodDark", { val: 0.55 });
  p.hline(x, y + Math.floor(h * 0.45) + 1, w, "woodDark", { val: 0.8, ny: 1 });
  // sill
  p.rect(x - 2, y + h, w + 4, 2, "woodDark", { val: 0.7, ny: -1 });
  p.rect(x - 2, y + h + 2, w + 4, 2, "woodDark", { val: 0.45 });
};

/** Shelf board with brackets. */
export const shelf = (p: P, x: number, y: number, w: number) => {
  p.hline(x, y, w, "woodDark", { val: 0.8, ny: -1 });
  p.rect(x, y + 1, w, 2, "woodDark", { val: 0.5 });
  for (const bx of [x + 2, x + w - 4]) {
    p.rect(bx, y + 3, 2, 3, "woodDark", { val: 0.4 });
    p.put(bx + 1, y + 6, "woodDark", { val: 0.35 });
  }
};

/** A row of books standing on a shelf at yBase, with the odd prop between them. */
export const books = (p: P, x: number, yBase: number, w: number, seed = 1, props: ("reel" | "jar" | "lean")[] = []) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  const mats: RampName[] = ["book1", "book2", "book3", "paper", "book1", "book2"];
  let cx = x;
  let pi = 0;
  while (cx < x + w - 2) {
    if (props[pi] && r() < 0.34) {
      const kind = props[pi++];
      if (kind === "reel") {
        p.disc(cx + 5, yBase - 6, 5.2, "metal", { val: 0.55 });
        p.ring(cx + 5, yBase - 6, 3.6, "metal", { val: 0.8 });
        for (const [dx, dy] of [[0, -2], [-2, 1], [2, 1]]) p.put(cx + 5 + dx, yBase - 6 + dy, "metal", { val: 0.12 });
        p.put(cx + 5, yBase - 6, "metal", { val: 0.9 });
        cx += 12;
        continue;
      }
      if (kind === "jar") {
        p.rect(cx + 1, yBase - 7, 5, 7, "paper", { val: 0.35 });
        p.vline(cx + 1, yBase - 7, 7, "paper", { val: 0.7 });
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) p.vline(cx + 2 + (k % 3), yBase - 11 + (k % 2), 4, k === 1 ? "book1" : "book2", { val: 0.7 });
        cx += 8;
        continue;
      }
      if (kind === "lean") {
        p.poly([[cx, yBase], [cx + 3, yBase], [cx + 9, yBase - 11], [cx + 6, yBase - 12]], "book3", { val: 0.6 });
        cx += 9;
        continue;
      }
    }
    const bw = 2 + Math.floor(r() * 3);
    const bh = 8 + Math.floor(r() * 6);
    const m = mats[Math.floor(r() * mats.length)];
    const v = 0.45 + r() * 0.3;
    p.rect(cx, yBase - bh, bw, bh, m, { val: v });
    p.vline(cx, yBase - bh, bh, m, { val: v * 0.6 });
    p.hline(cx + 1, yBase - bh + 2, bw - 1, m, { val: v + 0.3 });
    p.hline(cx + 1, yBase - 3, bw - 1, m, { val: v * 0.7 });
    cx += bw + (r() < 0.15 ? 1 : 0);
  }
};

/** Writing desk: lit top, front edge, deep shadow underneath, legs and a drawer unit. */
export const desk = (p: P, x: number, y: number, w: number, floorY: number) => {
  for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) p.rect(x, y + k, w, 1, "wood", { val: 0.6 + k * 0.02, ny: -1, jitter: 0.06, seed: 40 + k });
  for (let bx = x + 17; bx < x + w; bx += 23) p.vline(bx, y, 6, "wood", { val: 0.42, ny: -1 });
  p.hline(x, y + 6, w, "wood", { val: 0.95 });
  p.rect(x, y + 7, w, 3, "wood", { val: 0.55 });
  p.hline(x, y + 9, w, "wood", { val: 0.3 });
  p.rect(x + 2, y + 10, w - 4, floorY - y - 10, "plaster", { val: 0.12 });
  p.rect(x + 3, y + 10, 4, floorY - y - 10, "woodDark", { val: 0.42 });
  p.rect(x + w - 30, y + 10, 26, floorY - y - 13, "wood", { val: 0.38 });
  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
    const dy = y + 12 + k * 9;
    p.hline(x + w - 29, dy + 7, 24, "wood", { val: 0.18 });
    p.rect(x + w - 19, dy + 3, 4, 1, "metal", { val: 0.85 });
  }
};

/** Monitor casing and stand; the screen is drawn by a separate, dynamic layer. */
export const monitor = (p: P, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, standBase: number) => {
  p.rect(x, y, w, h, "metal", { val: 0.32 });
  p.hline(x, y, w, "metal", { val: 0.55, ny: -1 });
  p.vline(x, y, h, "metal", { val: 0.45 });
  p.hline(x, y + h - 1, w, "metal", { val: 0.22 });
  p.rect(x + 3, y + 3, w - 6, h - 6, "screen", { val: 0.2, emit: 0.12 });
  const cx = x + Math.floor(w / 2);
  p.rect(cx - 4, y + h, 8, standBase - (y + h) - 2, "metal", { val: 0.36 });
  p.vline(cx - 4, y + h, standBase - (y + h) - 2, "metal", { val: 0.55 });
  p.rect(cx - 10, standBase - 2, 20, 2, "metal", { val: 0.5, ny: -1 });
  p.put(x + w - 4, y + h - 2, "amberLamp", { val: 0.3, emit: 0.6 }); // power LED
};

/** Articulated desk lamp. Returns the bulb position and beam angle for the scene's light. */
export const deskLamp = (p: P, baseX: number, baseY: number) => {
  p.rect(baseX - 6, baseY - 3, 13, 3, "metal", { val: 0.5 });
  p.hline(baseX - 6, baseY - 3, 13, "metal", { val: 0.85, ny: -1 });
  const elbow: [number, number] = [baseX + 5, baseY - 28];
  const head: [number, number] = [baseX - 6, baseY - 40];
  for (const d of [0, 1]) {
    p.line(baseX + d, baseY - 3, elbow[0] + d, elbow[1], "metal", { val: 0.6 });
    p.line(elbow[0] + d, elbow[1], head[0] + d, head[1], "metal", { val: 0.6 });
  }
  p.disc(elbow[0], elbow[1], 1.6, "metal", { val: 0.85 });
  p.disc(head[0], head[1], 1.6, "metal", { val: 0.85 });
  // Shade: a cone aimed down-left at the keyboard. Thin metal glows faintly from
  // the bulb inside; the rim of the mouth is the hottest edge in the room.
  const shade: [number, number][] = [
    [head[0] + 3, head[1] - 4],
    [head[0] + 6, head[1] + 1],
    [head[0] - 4, head[1] + 15],
    [head[0] - 15, head[1] + 8],
  ];
  p.poly(shade, "amberLamp", { val: 0.3, emit: 0.04 });
  p.line(head[0] + 3, head[1] - 4, head[0] - 15, head[1] + 8, "amberLamp", { val: 0.6, ny: -1 });
  p.line(head[0] + 4, head[1] - 3, head[0] - 14, head[1] + 9, "amberLamp", { val: 0.45, ny: -1 });
  p.line(head[0] - 15, head[1] + 8, head[0] - 4, head[1] + 15, "amberLamp", { val: 1, emit: 0.62 });
  p.line(head[0] - 14, head[1] + 9, head[0] - 5, head[1] + 14, "amberLamp", { val: 1, emit: 0.9 });
  const bulb = { x: head[0] - 9, y: head[1] + 12 };
  return { bulb, angle: Math.atan2(1, -0.7), top: { x: head[0] - 5, y: head[1] - 1 } };
};

export const mug = (p: P, x: number, y: number) => {
  p.rect(x, y - 9, 7, 9, "paper", { val: 0.72 });
  p.vline(x, y - 9, 9, "paper", { val: 0.5 });
  p.vline(x + 6, y - 9, 9, "paper", { val: 0.55 });
  p.hline(x, y - 9, 7, "paper", { val: 0.95, ny: -1 });
  p.hline(x + 1, y - 8, 5, "woodDark", { val: 0.18 });
  p.ring(x + 8, y - 5, 2, "paper", { val: 0.62 });
  p.hline(x + 1, y - 4, 5, "book1", { val: 0.6 });
};

/** Potted pothos with heart leaves; vines trail over the desk edge. */
export const pothos = (p: P, x: number, y: number, seed = 7, trail = 18) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  p.poly([[x, y - 12], [x + 12, y - 12], [x + 11, y], [x + 1, y]], "mesa", { val: 0.6 });
  p.hline(x - 1, y - 13, 14, "mesa", { val: 0.85, ny: -1 });
  p.hline(x, y - 12, 12, "mesa", { val: 0.35 });
  const leaf = (lx: number, ly: number, s: number) => {
    const v = 0.45 + r() * 0.4;
    p.disc(lx, ly, s, "leaf", { val: v });
    p.put(lx - 1, ly - 1, "leaf", { val: v + 0.25 });
    p.put(lx, ly + s, "leaf", { val: v * 0.7 });
  };
  for (let k = 0; k < 9; k++) leaf(x + 1 + r() * 11, y - 15 - r() * 14, 1.4 + r() * 1.3);
  for (const side of [0, 1]) {
    let vx = x + (side ? 11 : 2);
    let vy = y - 12;
    for (let k = 0; k < trail; k++) {
      vx += side ? 0.6 + r() * 0.5 : -(0.2 + r() * 0.4);
      vy += 1;
      p.put(vx, vy, "leaf", { val: 0.4 });
      if (k % 3 === 1) leaf(vx + (side ? 1 : -1), vy, 1.2 + r() * 0.6);
    }
  }
};

export const keyboard = (p: P, x: number, y: number, w: number) => {
  p.rect(x, y, w, 4, "metal", { val: 0.3, ny: -1 });
  for (let row = 0; row < 3; row++)
    for (let k = x + 1 + (row % 2); k < x + w - 1; k += 2) p.put(k, y + row + (row ? 0 : 0), "paper", { val: 0.32 + (row === 0 ? 0.1 : 0), ny: -1 });
  p.hline(x, y + 4, w, "metal", { val: 0.6 });
};

export const sketchbooks = (p: P, x: number, y: number) => {
  const stack: [RampName, number, number][] = [["book1", 15, 0.5], ["paper", 13, 0.7], ["book2", 14, 0.55]];
  stack.forEach(([m, w, v], k) => {
    const yy = y - (k + 1) * 2;
    p.rect(x + k, yy, w, 2, m, { val: v });
    p.hline(x + k, yy, w, m, { val: v + 0.25, ny: -1 });
    p.hline(x + k + 1, yy + 1, w - 2, "paper", { val: 0.6 });
  });
};

/** Floorboards running toward the camera: rows get taller as they come closer. */
export const floor = (p: P, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, seed = 9) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  let yy = y;
  let rowH = 2;
  while (yy < y + h) {
    const v = 0.34 + r() * 0.08;
    p.rect(x, yy, w, rowH, "woodDark", { val: v, jitter: 0.06, seed: yy });
    p.hline(x, yy, w, "woodDark", { val: v * 0.45 });
    let jx = x + Math.floor(r() * 30);
    while (jx < x + w) {
      p.vline(jx, yy, rowH, "woodDark", { val: v * 0.5 });
      jx += 24 + Math.floor(r() * 30);
    }
    yy += rowH;
    rowH = Math.min(9, rowH + (r() < 0.6 ? 1 : 0));
  }
};

/** Round rug, seen at an angle. */
export const rug = (p: P, cx: number, cy: number, rx: number, ry: number) => {
  for (let y = Math.floor(cy - ry); y <= cy + ry; y++)
    for (let x = Math.floor(cx - rx); x <= cx + rx; x++) {
      const d = ((x - cx) / rx) ** 2 + ((y - cy) / ry) ** 2;
      if (d > 1) continue;
      const band = d > 0.82 ? 0.75 : d > 0.62 && d < 0.7 ? 0.62 : 0.45;
      p.put(x, y, "book1", { val: band, jitter: 0.05, ny: -1 });
    }
};

/** Dark foreground silhouette leaves (near layer, out of focus). */
export const hangingLeaves = (p: P, x: number, y: number, len: number, seed = 13) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  let vx = x;
  for (let k = 0; k < len; k++) {
    vx += (r() - 0.5) * 1.2;
    p.rect(vx, y + k, 1, 1, "leaf", { val: 0.22 });
    if (k % 5 === 2) {
      const s = 2.2 + r() * 2.2;
      const dir = r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
      p.disc(vx + dir * s, y + k + 1, s, "leaf", { val: 0.18 + r() * 0.12 });
    }
  }
};

==== 4409 src/kits/pixelstory/environment/template.ts
// "Template" versions of painted layers: the same world as an unfinished placeholder —
// flat neutral greys, dashed outlines on silhouettes and material edges, a layout grid,
// an X-box where an image should be. The only neutral greys in a film should mean
// "not alive yet". Composite with the living layer through a per-pixel mask.

import { bayer } from "../core/noise";
import { hexToRgb, type RGB } from "../core/palette";
import type { Albedo } from "./albedo";

export type TemplateStyle = {
  fill: string;
  line: string;
  /** Layout grid every `step` art px (set coordinates). */
  grid?: { step: number; color: string };
  /** An image placeholder (box with an X), set coordinates. */
  xbox?: { x0: number; y0: number; x1: number; y1: number };
  /** Material indices treated as another for outlines (texture shouldn't become line work). */
  alias?: Record<number, number>;
};

const cache = new WeakMap<Albedo, Map<string, Uint8ClampedArray>>();

export const templateOf = (a: Albedo, style: TemplateStyle): Uint8ClampedArray => {
  const key = JSON.stringify(style);
  let m = cache.get(a);
  if (!m) cache.set(a, (m = new Map()));
  const hit = m.get(key);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(a.w * a.h * 4);
  const fill = hexToRgb(style.fill);
  const line = hexToRgb(style.line);
  const grid = style.grid ? hexToRgb(style.grid.color) : null;
  const alias = style.alias ?? {};
  const matAt = (x: number, y: number) => {
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= a.w || y >= a.h) return 0;
    const m = a.mat[y * a.w + x];
    return alias[m] ?? m;
  };
  for (let y = 0; y < a.h; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < a.w; x++) {
      const i = y * a.w + x;
      if (!a.mat[i]) continue;
      const m0 = matAt(x, y);
      const sx = x + a.ox;
      const sy = y + a.oy;
      const edge = matAt(x - 1, y) !== m0 || matAt(x + 1, y) !== m0 || matAt(x, y - 1) !== m0 || matAt(x, y + 1) !== m0;
      let c: RGB = fill;
      if (grid && style.grid && (((sx % style.grid.step) + style.grid.step) % style.grid.step === 0 || ((sy % style.grid.step) + style.grid.step) % style.grid.step === 0)) c = grid;
      if (edge && ((sx + sy) >> 1) % 2 === 0) c = line;
      if (style.xbox) {
        const { x0, y0, x1, y1 } = style.xbox;
        if (sx >= x0 && sx <= x1 && sy >= y0 && sy <= y1) {
          const onBox = sx === x0 || sx === x1 || sy === y0 || sy === y1;
          const fx = (sx - x0) / (x1 - x0);
          const fy = (sy - y0) / (y1 - y0);
          const onX = Math.abs(fx - fy) * (x1 - x0) < 0.7 || Math.abs(fx - (1 - fy)) * (x1 - x0) < 0.7;
          c = onBox ? ((sx + sy) % 3 === 0 ? fill : line) : onX ? line : fill;
        }
      }
      out[i * 4] = c[0];
      out[i * 4 + 1] = c[1];
      out[i * 4 + 2] = c[2];
      out[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
    }
  m.set(key, out);
  return out;
};

export type Seam = { width: number; color: string; dither?: boolean };

/**
 * Per-pixel choice between the living and the template layer.
 * `mask(sx, sy)` returns a signed distance in art px: > 0 alive, < 0 template.
 * Pixels within `seam.width` of the boundary become the seam colour (Bayer-dithered),
 * so the change reads as a front of light moving through the world.
 */
export const compositeTemplate = (
  a: Albedo,
  alive: Uint8ClampedArray,
  tpl: Uint8ClampedArray,
  mask: (sx: number, sy: number) => number,
  seams: Seam[],
): Uint8ClampedArray => {
  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(alive.length);
  const seamRgb = seams.map((s) => ({ ...s, rgb: hexToRgb(s.color) }));
  for (let y = 0; y < a.h; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < a.w; x++) {
      const i = (y * a.w + x) * 4;
      if (!alive[i + 3] && !tpl[i + 3]) continue;
      const sx = x + a.ox;
      const sy = y + a.oy;
      const d = mask(sx, sy);
      let src = d >= 0 ? alive : tpl;
      let rgb: RGB | null = null;
      for (const s of seamRgb) {
        if (Math.abs(d) <= s.width && (!s.dither || (s.width - Math.abs(d)) / s.width > bayer(sx, sy) * 0.8)) {
          rgb = s.rgb;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!src[i + 3]) src = src === alive ? tpl : alive;
      if (rgb && src[i + 3]) {
        out[i] = rgb[0];
        out[i + 1] = rgb[1];
        out[i + 2] = rgb[2];
        out[i + 3] = 255;
      } else {
        out[i] = src[i];
        out[i + 1] = src[i + 1];
        out[i + 2] = src[i + 2];
        out[i + 3] = src[i + 3];
      }
    }
  return out;
};

==== 1613 src/kits/pixelstory/environment/TemplateView.tsx
import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { PixelCanvas } from "../pixel/PixelCanvas";
import { PX } from "../pixel/views";
import type { Albedo } from "./albedo";
import { relight, type Light, type RelightOpts } from "../lighting/relight";
import { compositeTemplate, templateOf, type Seam, type TemplateStyle } from "./template";

const aliveCache = new WeakMap<Albedo, Map<string, Uint8ClampedArray>>();
const aliveOf = (a: Albedo, lights: Light[], opts: RelightOpts) => {
  const key = JSON.stringify([lights, opts]);
  let m = aliveCache.get(a);
  if (!m) aliveCache.set(a, (m = new Map()));
  let px = m.get(key);
  if (!px) {
    px = relight(a, lights, opts);
    if (m.size > 4) m.clear();
    m.set(key, px);
  }
  return px;
};

type Props = {
  albedo: Albedo;
  lights?: Light[];
  opts: RelightOpts;
  style: TemplateStyle;
  /** Signed distance to the template boundary (> 0 alive). Omit when nothing is template. */
  mask?: ((sx: number, sy: number) => number) | null;
  seams?: Seam[];
};

/** A set layer that can be partly an unfinished template, partly alive. */
export const TemplateAlbedoView: React.FC<Props> = ({ albedo, lights = [], opts, style, mask, seams = [] }) => {
  const alive = aliveOf(albedo, lights, opts);
  const pixels = useMemo(
    () => (mask ? compositeTemplate(albedo, alive, templateOf(albedo, style), mask, seams) : alive),
    [albedo, alive, mask, style, seams],
  );
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: albedo.ox * PX, top: albedo.oy * PX }}>
      <PixelCanvas w={albedo.w} h={albedo.h} pixels={pixels} scale={PX} />
    </div>
  );
};

==== 3455 src/kits/pixelstory/example/cat.ts
// Example character for the PIXELSTORY kit: a small ginger cat, drawn the way every character in this
// style is built — flat fills per part → `finish` (sel-out outline + form shading from one upper-left
// key) → memoised frames → a pose function. Replace it with the buyer's own cast; keep the pattern.

import { finish, type FillSpec, type Material } from "../pixel/finish.ts";
import { recolor, sprite, type Palette, type Sprite } from "../pixel/sprite.ts";

export const CAT_PAL: Palette = {
  o: "#3D1A12", // outline (a dark version of the fur, never black)
  f: "#D98A3D", // fur
  F: "#A85A26", // fur shade
  y: "#F4B866", // fur light
  s: "#B8642A", // stripe
  S: "#8E4720", // stripe shade
  w: "#F3E6CC", // white muzzle, chest, paws
  v: "#CDB596", // white shade
  e: "#1B1115", // eye
  p: "#EE8E73", // nose
};

const FUR: Material = { base: "f", shade: "F", light: "y", out: "o" };
const STRIPE: Material = { base: "s", shade: "S", light: "s", out: "o" };
const WHITE: Material = { base: "w", shade: "v", light: "w", out: "o" };
const SPEC: Record<string, FillSpec> = {
  b: { mat: FUR, region: "fur" },
  s: { mat: STRIPE, region: "fur" },
  W: { mat: WHITE, region: "fur" },
  e: { keep: "e", region: "eye" },
  p: { keep: "p", region: "nose" },
};

// 18 × 11 fills, facing right. The head and body rows are shared; legs and tail change per frame.
const HEAD_BODY = [
  ".b.........bb...bb",
  ".b.........bbbbbbb",
  ".b.........bebbbeb",
  ".bb........bbWpWbb",
  "..bbsbbsbbbbbWWWb.",
  "..bbbsbbsbbbbbWb..",
  "..bbbbbbbbbbbbb...",
  "..bWWbbbbbbbbWb...",
];
const LEGS = {
  stride: ["..bb........bb....", ".bb..........bb...", ".WW..........WW..."],
  pass: ["...bb......bb.....", "....bb....bb......", "....WW....WW......"],
  stand: ["..bb.........bb...", "..bb.........bb...", "..WW.........WW..."],
} as const;
const SIT = [
  "...........bb...bb",
  "...........bbbbbbb",
  "...........bebbbeb",
  "...........bbWpWbb",
  "..........bbbWWWb.",
  ".........bbbbbWb..",
  "........bbsbbbbb..",
  ".......bbbsbbbbb..",
  ".......bbbbsbbbb..",
  ".bbbb..bbbbbbbWb..",
  "..bbbbbbWWbbbWW...",
];

export type CatPose = "stride" | "pass" | "stand" | "sit";

const cache = new Map<string, Sprite>();
const build = (pose: CatPose, tailFlick: boolean, blink: boolean): Sprite => {
  const key = `${pose}-${tailFlick}-${blink}`;
  const hit = cache.get(key);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const rows = pose === "sit" ? [...SIT] : [...HEAD_BODY, ...LEGS[pose]];
  // tail tip flicks one pixel back
  if (tailFlick && pose !== "sit") rows[0] = "b" + rows[0].slice(1).replace(/^b/, ".");
  let fill = sprite(rows);
  if (blink) fill = recolor(fill, { e: "b" });
  const out = finish(fill, SPEC);
  cache.set(key, out);
  return out;
};

/** Feet centre (art px inside the finished 20 × 13 sprite): place it on the floor line. */
export const CAT_ANCHOR = { x: 10, y: 12 };

/**
 * Pose for film frame `f` (60 fps clock). `walking` cycles stride/pass on fours (a pixel walk reads best
 * on a held, readable cadence); otherwise the cat stands or sits. Blinks every ~3 s.
 */
export const catAt = (f: number, state: "walk" | "stand" | "sit"): Sprite => {
  const blink = f % 190 < 6;
  if (state === "sit") return build("sit", false, blink);
  if (state === "stand") return build("stand", Math.floor(f / 40) % 3 === 0, blink);
  const step = Math.floor(f / 8) % 2;
  return build(step ? "pass" : "stride", step === 1, blink);
};

==== 7233 src/kits/pixelstory/example/PixelstoryExample.tsx
// PIXELSTORY technical example — a moonlit room, 8 s at any fps.
// A set painted once into albedo layers and relit every frame by two lights (moonlight cone through the
// window, a lantern that switches on), a cat sprite that receives the same light as it walks in and sits,
// dust in the moon shaft, a dolly with depth of field across layers, one line of pixel type.
// It is a technical check and a starting point, not a story: never reuse it as a buyer's film.
//
// Every time below is a film frame on a 60 fps clock (`f`), so the preview (30 fps) and the final
// (60 fps) play identically. The set is authored on a 1080 × 1920 stage (8 screen px per art px) and
// scaled to the render size.

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";
import { C } from "../core/palette.ts";
import { ease, keys, ramp } from "../core/motion.ts";
import { fbm1 } from "../core/noise.ts";
import { CinematicCamera, Layer, SCREEN } from "../camera/CinematicCamera.tsx";
import { cameraAt, drift } from "../camera/path.ts";
import { createAlbedo, painter } from "../environment/albedo.ts";
import { beam, books, floor, hangingLeaves, nightWindow, plankWall, pothos, rug, shelf } from "../environment/props.ts";
import { AlbedoView, SpriteView } from "../pixel/views.tsx";
import { DustMotes } from "../particles/particles.tsx";
import { Exposure, Glow, Grade, Grain, LightShaft, Vignette } from "../lighting/overlays.tsx";
import { spriteGainAt, spriteLightsAt } from "../lighting/spriteLight.ts";
import type { Light } from "../lighting/relight.ts";
import { PixelType } from "../typography/Type.tsx";
import { useFonts } from "../typography/fonts.ts";
import { CAT_ANCHOR, CAT_PAL, catAt } from "./cat.ts";

export const PIXELSTORY_EXAMPLE_SECONDS = 8;
const FILM_FPS = 60;

/** Floor line (art px) and the window / lantern positions shared by paint, lights and overlays. */
const FLOOR_Y = 196;
const WIN = { x: 72, y: 44, w: 42, h: 58 };
const MOON = { x: WIN.x + WIN.w / 2, y: WIN.y + WIN.h * 0.5, angle: 1.85, spread: 0.3 };
const MOON_POOL = { x: 54, y: 207 };
const LANTERN = { x: 22, y: 186 };

const buildSet = () => {
  // back wall layer: boards, beam, window, shelf with books
  const back = createAlbedo(167, 220, -16, -20);
  const b = painter(back);
  plankWall(b, -16, -20, 167, FLOOR_Y + 20, { seed: 21, base: 0.46 });
  beam(b, -16, 8, 167, 10, 8);
  nightWindow(b, WIN.x, WIN.y, WIN.w, WIN.h, 4);
  shelf(b, 8, 122, 44);
  books(b, 10, 122, 40, 6, ["jar", "lean"]);
  b.shade(-16, FLOOR_Y - 6, 167, 6, 0.6); // contact shadow where wall meets floor

  // floor layer: boards, rug, lantern, plant
  const front = createAlbedo(167, 90, -16, FLOOR_Y - 30);
  const p = painter(front);
  floor(p, -16, FLOOR_Y, 167, 50, 12);
  rug(p, 70, 214, 40, 7);
  // lantern: metal cap and base, amber glass
  p.rect(LANTERN.x - 5, FLOOR_Y - 2, 11, 2, "metal", { val: 0.5 });
  p.rect(LANTERN.x - 4, LANTERN.y - 6, 9, 14, "amberLamp", { val: 0.55, emit: 0.06 });
  for (const dx of [-4, 0, 4]) p.vline(LANTERN.x + dx, LANTERN.y - 6, 14, "metal", { val: 0.45 });
  p.poly([[LANTERN.x - 6, LANTERN.y - 6], [LANTERN.x + 6, LANTERN.y - 6], [LANTERN.x + 3, LANTERN.y - 10], [LANTERN.x - 3, LANTERN.y - 10]], "metal", { val: 0.6 });
  p.ring(LANTERN.x, LANTERN.y - 12, 2, "metal", { val: 0.7 });
  pothos(p, 106, FLOOR_Y + 2, 5, 10);

  // near layer: a dark trailing plant hanging into frame (out of focus)
  const near = createAlbedo(60, 90, -20, -10);
  hangingLeaves(painter(near), 4, -10, 70, 17);
  hangingLeaves(painter(near), 14, -10, 48, 23);
  return { back, front, near };
};

export const PixelstoryExample: React.FC = () => {
  useFonts();
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps, width } = useVideoConfig();
  const f = (frame / fps) * FILM_FPS;
  const set = useMemo(buildSet, []);

  // lights: moonlight breathes slightly; the lantern switches on at 4 s and flickers softly
  const lanternOn = ramp(f, 240, 300, ease.arriveSoft);
  const flicker = 1 + fbm1(f / 9, 4) * 0.12;
  const lights: (Light & { color?: string })[] = [
    { kind: "cone", x: MOON.x, y: MOON.y, r: 140, i: 1.0 + fbm1(f / 200, 2) * 0.05, angle: MOON.angle, spread: MOON.spread, color: "#CFE0FF" },
    // the pool the window throws on the floor (a cone alone fades out before it reaches the boards)
    { kind: "point", x: MOON_POOL.x, y: MOON_POOL.y, r: 30, i: 0.85, color: "#CFE0FF" },
    { kind: "point", x: LANTERN.x, y: LANTERN.y, r: 34, i: 2.1 * lanternOn * flicker, color: "#FFC46B" },
  ];
  const ambient = 0.14;
  const relightOpts = { ambient, exposure: 1.15, dither: 0.45 };

  // cat: walks in from the left, stops, sits and looks toward the window
  const catX = keys(f, [{ f: 30, v: -14 }, { f: 300, v: 60, e: ease.cameraSoft }]);
  const catState = f < 300 ? "walk" : f < 336 ? "stand" : "sit";
  const catY = FLOOR_Y + 6;

  // camera: slow dolly toward the cat with a gentle pan; focus on the floor layer
  const cam = cameraAt(f, [
    { f: 0, z: 0, x: 0, y: 30, focus: 1150, aperture: 7 },
    { f: 480, z: 170, x: -10, y: 150, e: ease.camera },
  ]);
  const d = drift(f, 5);

  const k = width / SCREEN.w;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: C.ink, overflow: "hidden" }}>
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 0, top: 0, width: SCREEN.w, height: SCREEN.h, transform: `scale(${k})`, transformOrigin: "0 0" }}>
        <CinematicCamera cam={{ ...cam, x: cam.x + d.x, y: cam.y + d.y, roll: d.roll }}>
          <Layer z={1500} maxBlur={6}>
            <AlbedoView albedo={set.back} lights={lights} opts={relightOpts} />
            <LightShaft id="moon" x={MOON.x} y={MOON.y} angle={MOON.angle} length={150} spread={MOON.spread} color="#CFE0FF" intensity={0.22} />
            <DustMotes frame={f} x={MOON.x} y={MOON.y} angle={MOON.angle} spread={MOON.spread} length={140} color="#E8F0FF" intensity={0.8} />
          </Layer>
          <Layer z={1150} maxBlur={8}>
            <AlbedoView albedo={set.front} lights={lights} opts={relightOpts} />
            <Glow x={LANTERN.x} y={LANTERN.y} r={14} color="#FFC46B" intensity={0.6 * lanternOn * flicker} />
            <SpriteView
              sprite={catAt(f, catState)}
              pal={CAT_PAL}
              anchor={CAT_ANCHOR}
              x={catX}
              y={catY}
              lights={spriteLightsAt(lights, catX, catY - 6)}
              gain={spriteGainAt(lights, catX, catY - 6, ambient)}
            />
          </Layer>
          <Layer z={700} maxBlur={14}>
            <AlbedoView albedo={set.near} lights={lights} opts={{ ambient: 0.1, exposure: 1, dither: 0.4 }} />
          </Layer>
        </CinematicCamera>
        {/* typewriter text grows to the right from a fixed start (centred text would slide while typing) */}
        <AbsoluteFill style={{ alignItems: "flex-start", paddingTop: 112, paddingLeft: 166 }}>
          <PixelType frame={f} start={350} text="MALAM YANG TENANG" size={44} color={C.ivory} perChar={3} />
        </AbsoluteFill>
        <Grade />
        <Vignette />
        <Grain frame={Math.floor(f)} />
        <Exposure color={C.ink} amount={1 - ramp(f, 0, 36, ease.arriveSoft)} />
      </div>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

==== 4598 src/kits/pixelstory/lighting/overlays.tsx
import React from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill } from "remotion";
import { rgba } from "../core/palette";
import { PX } from "../pixel/views";

// Lens and atmosphere: what the light does in the air and inside the camera.
// Positions are in set coordinates (art px) so these live inside a camera Layer.

/** Additive bloom around a practical light. */
export const Glow: React.FC<{
  x: number;
  y: number;
  r: number;
  color: string;
  intensity: number;
  squash?: number;
}> = ({ x, y, r, color, intensity, squash = 1 }) =>
  intensity <= 0.001 ? null : (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        left: (x - r) * PX,
        top: (y - r * squash) * PX,
        width: r * 2 * PX,
        height: r * 2 * squash * PX,
        borderRadius: "50%",
        background: `radial-gradient(closest-side, ${rgba(color, Math.min(1, intensity))} 0%, ${rgba(color, Math.min(1, intensity) * 0.35)} 38%, ${rgba(color, 0)} 100%)`,
        mixBlendMode: "screen",
        pointerEvents: "none",
      }}
    />
  );

/** Volumetric cone: light made visible by dust in the air. Soft-edged, never a wedge. */
export const LightShaft: React.FC<{
  x: number;
  y: number;
  angle: number;
  length: number;
  spread: number;
  color: string;
  intensity: number;
  id: string;
}> = ({ x, y, angle, length, spread, color, intensity, id }) => {
  const L = length * PX;
  const H = Math.tan(spread) * L;
  const pad = 80;
  return (
    <svg
      width={L + pad * 2}
      height={H * 2 + pad * 2}
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        left: x * PX - pad,
        top: y * PX - H - pad,
        transformOrigin: `${pad}px ${H + pad}px`,
        transform: `rotate(${angle}rad)`,
        mixBlendMode: "screen",
        pointerEvents: "none",
        overflow: "visible",
      }}
    >
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={`${id}-g`} x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="0">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor={color} stopOpacity={intensity} />
          <stop offset="0.55" stopColor={color} stopOpacity={intensity * 0.4} />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor={color} stopOpacity={0} />
        </linearGradient>
        <filter id={`${id}-b`} x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="22" />
        </filter>
      </defs>
      <polygon
        points={`${pad},${H + pad - 10} ${L + pad},${pad} ${L + pad},${H * 2 + pad} ${pad},${H + pad + 10}`}
        fill={`url(#${id}-g)`}
        filter={`url(#${id}-b)`}
      />
    </svg>
  );
};

/** Optical vignette with a warm-dark falloff (never neutral black). */
export const Vignette: React.FC<{ strength?: number; color?: string; cx?: string; cy?: string }> = ({
  strength = 0.75,
  color = "#0D0809",
  cx = "50%",
  cy = "48%",
}) => (
  <AbsoluteFill
    style={{
      background: `radial-gradient(ellipse 78% 62% at ${cx} ${cy}, ${rgba(color, 0)} 45%, ${rgba(color, strength * 0.55)} 78%, ${rgba(color, strength)} 100%)`,
      pointerEvents: "none",
    }}
  />
);

/** Film grain: seeded per frame so it is deterministic, light enough to stay texture. */
export const Grain: React.FC<{ frame: number; opacity?: number }> = ({ frame, opacity = 0.07 }) => (
  <AbsoluteFill style={{ mixBlendMode: "overlay", opacity, pointerEvents: "none" }}>
    <svg width="1080" height="1920" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <filter id={`grain-${frame}`}>
        <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="2" seed={frame % 97} stitchTiles="stitch" />
        <feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0" />
      </filter>
      <rect width="1080" height="1920" filter={`url(#grain-${frame})`} />
    </svg>
  </AbsoluteFill>
);

/**
 * Split-tone grade: shadows pushed toward wine, highlights toward gold.
 * Applied once over the whole frame so every shot shares one look.
 */
export const Grade: React.FC<{ shadows?: string; highlights?: string; amount?: number }> = ({
  shadows = "#3D141D",
  highlights = "#F4B860",
  amount = 1,
}) => (
  <>
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: shadows, mixBlendMode: "lighten", opacity: 0.12 * amount, pointerEvents: "none" }} />
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: highlights, mixBlendMode: "soft-light", opacity: 0.08 * amount, pointerEvents: "none" }} />
  </>
);

/** Exposure flash / fade to a colour. */
export const Exposure: React.FC<{ color: string; amount: number; blend?: React.CSSProperties["mixBlendMode"] }> = ({
  color,
  amount,
  blend = "normal",
}) => (amount <= 0.001 ? null : <AbsoluteFill style={{ background: color, opacity: amount, mixBlendMode: blend, pointerEvents: "none" }} />);

==== 3034 src/kits/pixelstory/lighting/relight.ts
// Per-pixel relighting of albedo buffers into hand-picked colour ramps.
// Light is accumulated as a scalar and quantised to the material's ramp; the
// fractional part is resolved with a 4×4 Bayer matrix, which gives the soft, stepped
// falloff of hand-dithered pixel art instead of a smooth digital gradient.

import { RAMPS, hexToRgb, type RGB } from "../core/palette.ts";
import { bayer } from "../core/noise.ts";
import { MATERIALS, type Albedo } from "../environment/albedo.ts";

export type Light =
  | { kind: "point"; x: number; y: number; r: number; i: number }
  | {
      kind: "cone";
      x: number;
      y: number;
      r: number;
      i: number;
      /** Direction of the cone, radians (0 = +x, π/2 = down). */
      angle: number;
      /** Half-angle of the bright core, radians. */
      spread: number;
    };

export type RelightOpts = {
  ambient: number;
  exposure?: number;
  /**
   * Width of the dithered band around each ramp step, 0..1. Values near the middle
   * of a step stay flat; only transitions are dithered, as a pixel artist would.
   */
  dither?: number;
};

const RAMP_RGB: RGB[][] = [[], ...MATERIALS.map((m) => RAMPS[m].map(hexToRgb))];

export const relight = (a: Albedo, lights: Light[], o: RelightOpts): Uint8ClampedArray => {
  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(a.w * a.h * 4);
  const exposure = o.exposure ?? 1;
  const band = Math.max(0.0001, (o.dither ?? 0.45) * 0.5);
  for (let y = 0; y < a.h; y++) {
    const sy = y + a.oy + 0.5;
    for (let x = 0; x < a.w; x++) {
      const i = y * a.w + x;
      const m = a.mat[i];
      if (!m) continue;
      const sx = x + a.ox + 0.5;
      let L = o.ambient;
      const nx = a.nx[i];
      const ny = a.ny[i];
      for (const l of lights) {
        const dx = l.x - sx;
        const dy = l.y - sy;
        const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        let c = l.i / (1 + (d2 / (l.r * l.r)) * 3);
        if (nx || ny) {
          const d = Math.sqrt(d2) || 1;
          const f = (nx * dx + ny * dy) / (d * Math.hypot(nx, ny));
          c *= f > 0 ? 0.25 + 0.95 * f : 0.12;
        }
        if (l.kind === "cone") {
          let diff = Math.atan2(-dy, -dx) - l.angle;
          diff = Math.atan2(Math.sin(diff), Math.cos(diff));
          const t = Math.abs(diff);
          const edge = l.spread * 1.7;
          c *= t <= l.spread ? 1 : t >= edge ? 0.08 : 0.08 + 0.92 * (1 - (t - l.spread) / (edge - l.spread)) ** 2;
        }
        L += c;
      }
      const v = a.val[i] * L * exposure + a.emit[i];
      const ramp = RAMP_RGB[m];
      const top = ramp.length - 1;
      const f = Math.max(0, Math.min(top, v * top));
      let k = Math.floor(f);
      const frac = f - k;
      if (frac >= 0.5 + band) k++;
      else if (frac > 0.5 - band && (frac - (0.5 - band)) / (2 * band) > bayer(x + a.ox, y + a.oy)) k++;
      if (k > top) k = top;
      const rgb = ramp[k];
      const p = i * 4;
      out[p] = rgb[0];
      out[p + 1] = rgb[1];
      out[p + 2] = rgb[2];
      out[p + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  return out;
};

==== 1473 src/kits/pixelstory/lighting/spriteLight.ts
import type { Light } from "./relight";
import type { SpriteLight } from "../pixel/sprite";

const strengthAt = (l: Light, x: number, y: number) => {
  const dx = l.x - x;
  const dy = l.y - y;
  let c = l.i / (1 + ((dx * dx + dy * dy) / (l.r * l.r)) * 3);
  if (l.kind === "cone") {
    let diff = Math.atan2(-dy, -dx) - l.angle;
    diff = Math.atan2(Math.sin(diff), Math.cos(diff));
    c *= Math.abs(diff) < l.spread * 1.7 ? 1 : 0.15;
  }
  return c;
};

/**
 * The same lights that relight the set, translated into what a sprite at (x, y)
 * receives: a rim on the side facing each light, scaled by how much reaches it.
 */
export const spriteLightsAt = (
  lights: (Light & { color?: string })[],
  x: number,
  y: number,
  opts: { rim?: number; core?: number; width?: number } = {},
): SpriteLight[] =>
  lights
    .map((l) => {
      const c = strengthAt(l, x, y);
      return {
        dir: [l.x - x, l.y - y] as [number, number],
        color: l.color ?? "#FFD08A",
        rim: Math.min(0.95, c * (opts.rim ?? 0.9)),
        core: opts.core ?? 0.25,
        width: opts.width ?? 1,
      };
    })
    .filter((l) => l.rim > 0.04)
    .sort((a, b) => a.rim - b.rim);

/** Overall exposure of a sprite in a dark set: never black, never flat. */
export const spriteGainAt = (lights: Light[], x: number, y: number, ambient: number) => {
  const total = lights.reduce((s, l) => s + strengthAt(l, x, y), ambient);
  return Math.min(1.08, 0.42 + total * 0.38);
};

==== 4415 src/kits/pixelstory/particles/particles.tsx
import React from "react";
import { hash } from "../core/noise";
import { rgba } from "../core/palette";
import { PX } from "../pixel/views";

// Particles only where something motivates them: dust that is visible because a
// beam crosses it, steam because the coffee is hot, a trail because something bright
// moved. Every particle is a whole art pixel, never a soft dot.

const Px: React.FC<{ x: number; y: number; color: string; a: number; size?: number }> = ({ x, y, color, a, size = 1 }) =>
  a <= 0.02 ? null : (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        left: Math.round(x) * PX,
        top: Math.round(y) * PX,
        width: size * PX,
        height: size * PX,
        background: rgba(color, Math.min(1, a)),
      }}
    />
  );

/** Dust motes that only show inside a light cone. */
export const DustMotes: React.FC<{
  frame: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  angle: number;
  spread: number;
  length: number;
  count?: number;
  color?: string;
  intensity?: number;
  seed?: number;
}> = ({ frame, x, y, angle, spread, length, count = 28, color = "#FFD596", intensity = 1, seed = 3 }) => (
  <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, mixBlendMode: "screen" }}>
    {Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
      const d = 6 + hash(i * 7 + seed) * (length - 6);
      const a0 = angle + (hash(i * 13 + seed) - 0.5) * spread * 2.2;
      const t = frame / 60;
      const px = x + Math.cos(a0) * d + Math.sin(t * 0.35 + i * 1.7) * 2.2;
      const py = y + Math.sin(a0) * d - ((t * (0.6 + hash(i) * 0.8) + hash(i * 3) * 40) % 40) * 0.25 + Math.cos(t * 0.5 + i) * 1.2;
      let diff = Math.atan2(py - y, px - x) - angle;
      diff = Math.atan2(Math.sin(diff), Math.cos(diff));
      const inCone = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(diff) / (spread * 1.2));
      const dist = Math.hypot(px - x, py - y);
      const fall = Math.max(0, 1 - dist / length);
      const twinkle = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 2.3 + i * 4.1);
      return <Px key={i} x={px} y={py} color={color} a={inCone * fall * twinkle * intensity * 0.9} />;
    })}
  </div>
);

/** Rising steam: pixel puffs that drift, thin out and vanish. */
export const Steam: React.FC<{ frame: number; x: number; y: number; intensity?: number; seed?: number }> = ({
  frame,
  x,
  y,
  intensity = 1,
  seed = 1,
}) => (
  <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0 }}>
    {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => {
      const period = 150;
      const t = ((frame + i * (period / 6) + seed * 37) % period) / period;
      const px = x + Math.sin(t * 5 + i * 2) * 1.6 + t * 2;
      const py = y - t * 22;
      const a = Math.sin(Math.PI * t) * 0.32 * intensity;
      return <Px key={i} x={px} y={py} color="#F3E6CC" a={a} size={t < 0.4 ? 1 : 2} />;
    })}
  </div>
);

/** Afterglow behind a moving light: sampled from its own path, so it can never drift off it. */
export const Trail: React.FC<{
  frame: number;
  path: (f: number) => { x: number; y: number } | null;
  length?: number;
  step?: number;
  color?: string;
  intensity?: number;
}> = ({ frame, path, length = 18, step = 2, color = "#FFD27A", intensity = 1 }) => (
  <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, mixBlendMode: "screen" }}>
    {Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => {
      const f = frame - (i + 1) * step;
      const p = path(f);
      if (!p) return null;
      const age = (i + 1) / length;
      const jitter = (hash(Math.floor(f / 2) * 31 + i) - 0.5) * 2 * age;
      return <Px key={i} x={p.x + jitter} y={p.y + jitter * 0.6} color={color} a={(1 - age) ** 1.6 * intensity} />;
    })}
  </div>
);

/** Pixels thrown off a breaking surface: each flies on its own ballistic path. */
export const Debris: React.FC<{
  frame: number;
  start: number;
  pieces: { x: number; y: number; color: string }[];
  spread?: number;
  gravity?: number;
  life?: number;
  seed?: number;
}> = ({ frame, start, pieces, spread = 1, gravity = 0.03, life = 50, seed = 5 }) => {
  const t = frame - start;
  if (t < 0 || t > life) return null;
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0 }}>
      {pieces.map((p, i) => {
        const vx = (hash(i * 3 + seed) - 0.5) * 0.9 * spread;
        const vy = (-0.25 - hash(i * 5 + seed) * 0.5) * spread;
        const x = p.x + vx * t;
        const y = p.y + vy * t + gravity * t * t;
        return <Px key={i} x={x} y={y} color={p.color} a={1 - t / life} />;
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

==== 2233 src/kits/pixelstory/pixel/finish.ts
// "Finishing" pass for hand-drawn fill art: selective outlines (sel-out) and form
// shading from a fixed upper-left key, so every sprite in the film shares one light
// logic. The artist draws flat regions; this pass adds the craft that keeps them
// consistent (outline colour is a dark version of the material it wraps, never black).

import type { Sprite } from "./sprite.ts";

export type Material = { base: string; shade: string; light: string; out: string };

/** How a fill character behaves: which material, which region (for seams), or kept as-is. */
export type FillSpec = { mat?: Material; region: string; keep?: string };

export const finish = (fill: Sprite, spec: Record<string, FillSpec>, pad = 1): Sprite => {
  const W = fill.w + pad * 2;
  const H = fill.h + pad * 2;
  const at = (x: number, y: number) => {
    const fx = x - pad;
    const fy = y - pad;
    if (fx < 0 || fy < 0 || fx >= fill.w || fy >= fill.h) return ".";
    return fill.cells[fy * fill.w + fx];
  };
  const region = (c: string) => (c === "." ? "" : spec[c]?.region ?? c);
  const cells: string[] = new Array(W * H).fill(".");

  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      const c = at(x, y);
      if (c === ".") {
        // Outline: take the material of the nearest opaque neighbour (below first, so
        // feet and chins pick the right colour).
        for (const [dx, dy] of [[0, 1], [0, -1], [-1, 0], [1, 0]]) {
          const n = at(x + dx, y + dy);
          if (n === ".") continue;
          const s = spec[n];
          cells[y * W + x] = s?.mat?.out ?? s?.keep ?? n;
          break;
        }
        continue;
      }
      const s = spec[c];
      if (!s) {
        cells[y * W + x] = c;
        continue;
      }
      if (s.keep) {
        cells[y * W + x] = s.keep;
        continue;
      }
      const m = s.mat!;
      const r = s.region;
      const dr = region(at(x + 1, y + 1));
      const ul = at(x - 1, y - 1);
      const u = at(x, y - 1);
      if (dr !== r) cells[y * W + x] = m.shade;
      else if ((ul === "." && u === ".") || (u === "." && at(x - 1, y) === ".")) cells[y * W + x] = m.light;
      else cells[y * W + x] = m.base;
    }
  }
  return { w: W, h: H, cells };
};

==== 1050 src/kits/pixelstory/pixel/PixelCanvas.tsx
import React, { useLayoutEffect, useRef } from "react";

type Props = {
  /** Art-pixel width and height of the buffer. */
  w: number;
  h: number;
  /** RGBA buffer, w*h*4. */
  pixels: Uint8ClampedArray;
  /** Screen pixels per art pixel. */
  scale: number;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
};

/**
 * Draws an RGBA buffer at native art resolution and lets the compositor scale it with
 * nearest-neighbour sampling, so pixels stay hard at any camera zoom.
 */
export const PixelCanvas: React.FC<Props> = ({ w, h, pixels, scale, style }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const ctx = ref.current?.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    const img = new ImageData(w, h);
    img.data.set(pixels);
    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  }, [w, h, pixels]);
  return (
    <canvas
      ref={ref}
      width={w}
      height={h}
      style={{
        width: w * scale,
        height: h * scale,
        imageRendering: "pixelated",
        display: "block",
        ...style,
      }}
    />
  );
};

==== 4215 src/kits/pixelstory/pixel/sprite.ts
// Palette-indexed sprites. Pure data + pure functions so the same art is used by the
// film, the character sheet and the PNG exporter (scripts/export-sprites.mjs).

import { hexToRgb, type RGB } from "../core/palette.ts";

export type Sprite = { w: number; h: number; cells: string[] };
export type Palette = Record<string, string>;

/** Build a sprite from ASCII rows. '.' and ' ' are transparent. */
export const sprite = (rows: string[]): Sprite => {
  const w = Math.max(...rows.map((r) => r.length));
  const cells: string[] = [];
  for (const r of rows) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) cells.push(r[x] && r[x] !== " " ? r[x] : ".");
  return { w, h: rows.length, cells };
};

export const blank = (w: number, h: number): Sprite => ({ w, h, cells: new Array(w * h).fill(".") });

export const flipX = (s: Sprite): Sprite => {
  const cells: string[] = new Array(s.w * s.h);
  for (let y = 0; y < s.h; y++)
    for (let x = 0; x < s.w; x++) cells[y * s.w + x] = s.cells[y * s.w + (s.w - 1 - x)];
  return { w: s.w, h: s.h, cells };
};

/** Copy every opaque pixel of `src` into `dst` at (ox, oy). Later layers win. */
export const stamp = (dst: Sprite, src: Sprite, ox: number, oy: number, flip = false) => {
  const ix = Math.round(ox);
  const iy = Math.round(oy);
  for (let y = 0; y < src.h; y++) {
    const dy = iy + y;
    if (dy < 0 || dy >= dst.h) continue;
    for (let x = 0; x < src.w; x++) {
      const c = src.cells[y * src.w + (flip ? src.w - 1 - x : x)];
      if (c === ".") continue;
      const dx = ix + x;
      if (dx < 0 || dx >= dst.w) continue;
      dst.cells[dy * dst.w + dx] = c;
    }
  }
  return dst;
};

/** Replace characters (palette swaps for blinks, flashes, states). */
export const recolor = (s: Sprite, map: Record<string, string>): Sprite => ({
  ...s,
  cells: s.cells.map((c) => map[c] ?? c),
});

export type SpriteLight = {
  /** Direction the light comes FROM, in sprite space (e.g. [-1,-1] = upper left). */
  dir: [number, number];
  color: string;
  /** 0..1 strength of the rim on edges facing the light. */
  rim: number;
  /** 0..1 darkening of edges facing away from the light. */
  core?: number;
  /** 0..1 overall tint toward the light colour (bounce/fill). */
  fill?: number;
  /** Width of the rim in pixels (1 or 2). */
  width?: number;
};

const mix = (a: RGB, b: RGB, t: number): RGB => [
  a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t,
  a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t,
  a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t,
];

const rgbCache = new Map<string, RGB>();
const toRgb = (hex: string) => {
  let v = rgbCache.get(hex);
  if (!v) {
    v = hexToRgb(hex);
    rgbCache.set(hex, v);
  }
  return v;
};

/**
 * Rasterise to RGBA with directional pixel lighting: pixels whose neighbour toward the
 * light is empty get a rim, pixels whose neighbour away from the light is empty fall
 * into core shadow. This is how a sprite "receives" a moving light source.
 */
export const rasterize = (s: Sprite, pal: Palette, lights: SpriteLight[] = [], alpha = 1, gain = 1) => {
  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(s.w * s.h * 4);
  const opaque = (x: number, y: number) =>
    x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < s.w && y < s.h && s.cells[y * s.w + x] !== ".";
  for (let y = 0; y < s.h; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < s.w; x++) {
      const c = s.cells[y * s.w + x];
      if (c === ".") continue;
      const hex = pal[c];
      if (!hex) continue;
      let rgb = toRgb(hex);
      if (gain !== 1) rgb = [rgb[0] * gain, rgb[1] * gain, rgb[2] * gain];
      for (const L of lights) {
        const lc = toRgb(L.color);
        const n = Math.hypot(L.dir[0], L.dir[1]) || 1;
        const dx = Math.round(L.dir[0] / n);
        const dy = Math.round(L.dir[1] / n);
        if (L.fill) rgb = mix(rgb, lc, L.fill * 0.5);
        const w = L.width ?? 1;
        let rimHit = 0;
        for (let k = 1; k <= w; k++) if (!opaque(x + dx * k, y + dy * k)) rimHit = Math.max(rimHit, 1 - (k - 1) * 0.55);
        if (rimHit) rgb = mix(rgb, lc, L.rim * rimHit);
        if (L.core && !opaque(x - dx, y - dy)) rgb = mix(rgb, [12, 6, 8], L.core);
      }
      const i = (y * s.w + x) * 4;
      out[i] = rgb[0];
      out[i + 1] = rgb[1];
      out[i + 2] = rgb[2];
      out[i + 3] = 255 * alpha;
    }
  }
  return out;
};

==== 2389 src/kits/pixelstory/pixel/views.tsx
import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { PixelCanvas } from "./PixelCanvas";
import { rasterize, type Palette, type Sprite, type SpriteLight } from "./sprite";
import type { Albedo } from "../environment/albedo";
import { relight, type Light, type RelightOpts } from "../lighting/relight";

/** Screen pixels per art pixel for every set in the film. One pixel scale, no mixels. */
export const PX = 8;

type SpriteViewProps = {
  sprite: Sprite;
  pal: Palette;
  /** Anchor point inside the sprite (art px), placed at (x, y) in set coordinates. */
  anchor: { x: number; y: number };
  x: number;
  y: number;
  lights?: SpriteLight[];
  gain?: number;
  flip?: boolean;
  opacity?: number;
  scale?: number;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
};

export const SpriteView: React.FC<SpriteViewProps> = ({
  sprite,
  pal,
  anchor,
  x,
  y,
  lights = [],
  gain = 1,
  flip = false,
  opacity = 1,
  scale = PX,
  style,
}) => {
  const pixels = useMemo(() => rasterize(sprite, pal, lights, 1, gain), [sprite, pal, lights, gain]);
  // On the set's own pixel scale, snap to the art grid so the sprite never sits between
  // pixels. Sprites drawn smaller (distant objects) are placed freely.
  const left = scale === PX ? Math.round(x - anchor.x) * PX : x * PX - anchor.x * scale;
  const top = scale === PX ? Math.round(y - anchor.y) * PX : y * PX - anchor.y * scale;
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "absolute",
        left,
        top,
        opacity,
        transform: flip ? "scaleX(-1)" : undefined,
        transformOrigin: `${anchor.x * scale}px ${anchor.y * scale}px`,
        ...style,
      }}
    >
      <PixelCanvas w={sprite.w} h={sprite.h} pixels={pixels} scale={scale} />
    </div>
  );
};

type AlbedoViewProps = {
  albedo: Albedo;
  lights: Light[];
  opts: RelightOpts;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
};

/** A painted set layer, relit for the current frame. */
export const AlbedoView: React.FC<AlbedoViewProps> = ({ albedo, lights, opts, style }) => {
  const key = JSON.stringify([lights, opts]);
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const pixels = useMemo(() => relight(albedo, lights, opts), [albedo, key]);
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: albedo.ox * PX, top: albedo.oy * PX, ...style }}>
      <PixelCanvas w={albedo.w} h={albedo.h} pixels={pixels} scale={PX} />
    </div>
  );
};

==== 1513 src/kits/pixelstory/typography/fonts.ts
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { continueRender, delayRender, staticFile } from "remotion";

// Bundled OFL fonts (licences in public/fonts/licenses). Loaded through the FontFace
// API and held with delayRender so no frame is ever captured with a fallback face.

export const FONT = {
  display: "PS Anton",
  serif: "PS Instrument Serif",
  pixel: "PS Silkscreen",
  sans: "PS Space Grotesk",
} as const;

const FACES: [string, string, FontFaceDescriptors][] = [
  [FONT.display, "fonts/Anton-Regular.ttf", {}],
  [FONT.serif, "fonts/InstrumentSerif-Italic.ttf", { style: "italic" }],
  [FONT.serif, "fonts/InstrumentSerif-Regular.ttf", { style: "normal" }],
  [FONT.pixel, "fonts/Silkscreen-Regular.ttf", { weight: "400" }],
  [FONT.pixel, "fonts/Silkscreen-Bold.ttf", { weight: "700" }],
  [FONT.sans, "fonts/SpaceGrotesk-Variable.ttf", { weight: "300 700" }],
];

let loading: Promise<void> | null = null;
const loadAll = () =>
  (loading ??= Promise.all(
    FACES.map(([family, file, desc]) =>
      new FontFace(family, `url(${staticFile(file)})`, desc).load().then((f) => {
        (document.fonts as unknown as { add(face: FontFace): void }).add(f);
      }),
    ),
  ).then(() => undefined));

export const useFonts = () => {
  const [handle] = useState(() => delayRender("Loading fonts"));
  useEffect(() => {
    loadAll()
      .then(() => continueRender(handle))
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error(err);
        continueRender(handle);
      });
  }, [handle]);
};

==== 7075 src/kits/pixelstory/typography/Type.tsx
import React from "react";
import { clamp, ease, ramp, type Ease } from "../core/motion";
import { hash } from "../core/noise";
import { C, rgba } from "../core/palette";
import { FONT } from "./fonts";

// Each treatment exists for a reason in the story; none of them is a generic
// "word pops in". Pick by purpose:
//   MaskRise     — a statement arriving from behind a line (horizon, edge of frame)
//   LightSweep   — words that become visible because a light passes over them
//   PixelType    — diegetic pixel text, typed at the cadence of a machine
//   Counter      — a number that is counting something on screen
//   Crumble      — a word breaking into the style's own unit, the pixel

export type LineSpec = {
  text: string;
  font?: string;
  size: number;
  color?: string;
  italic?: boolean;
  tracking?: number;
  weight?: number | string;
  /** Horizontal offset in px, for asymmetric lockups. */
  dx?: number;
  shadow?: string;
};

const lineStyle = (l: LineSpec): React.CSSProperties => ({
  fontFamily: l.font ?? FONT.display,
  fontSize: l.size,
  lineHeight: 0.92,
  color: l.color ?? C.ivory,
  fontStyle: l.italic ? "italic" : "normal",
  fontWeight: l.weight ?? 400,
  letterSpacing: `${l.tracking ?? 0}em`,
  whiteSpace: "pre",
  textShadow: l.shadow,
});

/** Lines rise into view from behind their own baseline mask. */
export const MaskRise: React.FC<{
  frame: number;
  start: number;
  lines: LineSpec[];
  stagger?: number;
  duration?: number;
  curve?: Ease;
  exitAt?: number;
  exitDuration?: number;
  align?: "left" | "center" | "right";
  gap?: number;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}> = ({ frame, start, lines, stagger = 7, duration = 26, curve = ease.arrive, exitAt, exitDuration = 18, align = "center", gap = 0, style }) => (
  <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: align === "center" ? "center" : align === "left" ? "flex-start" : "flex-end", gap, ...style }}>
    {lines.map((l, i) => {
      const t = ramp(frame, start + i * stagger, start + i * stagger + duration, curve);
      const out = exitAt === undefined ? 0 : ramp(frame, exitAt + i * 3, exitAt + i * 3 + exitDuration, ease.depart);
      const y = (1 - t) * 108 - out * 108;
      return (
        <div key={i} style={{ overflow: "hidden", paddingTop: l.size * 0.08, paddingBottom: l.size * 0.04, marginLeft: l.dx ?? 0 }}>
          <div style={{ ...lineStyle(l), transform: `translateY(${y}%)` }}>{l.text}</div>
        </div>
      );
    })}
  </div>
);

/**
 * The words exist in the dark and are lit by a passing light: unlit → gold edge → ivory.
 * `progress` 0..1 is the light's position across the line (drive it from a real light).
 */
export const LightSweep: React.FC<{
  progress: number;
  line: LineSpec;
  edge?: string;
  softness?: number;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}> = ({ progress, line, edge = C.gold, softness = 10, style }) => {
  const p = progress * (100 + softness * 2) - softness;
  const base = line.color ?? C.ivory;
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        ...lineStyle(line),
        color: "transparent",
        backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${base} 0%, ${base} ${p - softness}%, ${edge} ${p - softness * 0.25}%, ${rgba(edge, 0)} ${p + softness * 0.4}%, ${rgba(edge, 0)} 100%)`,
        WebkitBackgroundClip: "text",
        backgroundClip: "text",
        paddingBottom: line.size * 0.12,
        ...style,
      }}
    >
      {line.text}
    </div>
  );
};

/** Typed at a fixed machine cadence with a block cursor. */
export const PixelType: React.FC<{
  frame: number;
  start: number;
  text: string;
  size: number;
  color?: string;
  perChar?: number;
  cursor?: boolean;
  tracking?: number;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}> = ({ frame, start, text, size, color = C.ivory, perChar = 2, cursor = true, tracking = 0.12, style }) => {
  const n = clamp(Math.floor((frame - start) / perChar), 0, text.length);
  const done = n >= text.length;
  const blink = Math.floor(frame / 16) % 2 === 0;
  return (
    <div style={{ fontFamily: FONT.pixel, fontSize: size, color, letterSpacing: `${tracking}em`, whiteSpace: "pre", lineHeight: 1, ...style }}>
      {frame < start ? "" : text.slice(0, n)}
      {cursor && frame >= start && (!done || blink) ? (
        <span style={{ display: "inline-block", width: size * 0.6, height: size * 0.8, background: color, marginLeft: size * 0.08, verticalAlign: "-0.05em" }} />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
};

/** A zero-padded counter that eases toward its target like a projector spinning up. */
export const Counter: React.FC<{
  frame: number;
  from: number;
  to: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  digits?: number;
  size: number;
  color?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}> = ({ frame, from, to, start, end, digits = 4, size, color = C.ivoryDim, style }) => {
  const t = ramp(frame, start, end, (x) => x * x * (3 - 2 * x));
  const v = Math.round(from + (to - from) * t);
  return (
    <div style={{ fontFamily: FONT.pixel, fontSize: size, color, letterSpacing: "0.1em", lineHeight: 1, ...style }}>
      {String(v).padStart(digits, "0")}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * A word breaks into tiles that fall away along a wave front (origin → outward).
 * Tiles are the style's pixel: the word dies the way the template does.
 */
export const Crumble: React.FC<{
  frame: number;
  start: number;
  line: LineSpec;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  tile?: number;
  /** Wave origin in px within the box, and speed in px per frame. */
  origin?: { x: number; y: number };
  speed?: number;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}> = ({ frame, start, line, width, height, tile = 24, origin = { x: 0, y: height / 2 }, speed = 30, style }) => {
  const cols = Math.ceil(width / tile);
  const rows = Math.ceil(height / tile);
  const t = frame - start;
  return (
    <div style={{ position: "relative", width, height, ...style }}>
      {Array.from({ length: cols * rows }, (_, i) => {
        const cx = (i % cols) * tile;
        const cy = Math.floor(i / cols) * tile;
        const reach = Math.hypot(cx - origin.x, cy - origin.y) / speed + hash(i) * 4;
        const life = t - reach;
        if (life > 40) return null;
        const fall = life > 0 ? life : 0;
        const dx = fall * (hash(i * 3) - 0.3) * 2.2;
        const dy = fall * fall * 0.35 - fall * 2.5 * hash(i * 7);
        const op = life > 0 ? clamp(1 - life / 34) : 1;
        return (
          <div
            key={i}
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: cx,
              top: cy,
              width: tile,
              height: tile,
              overflow: "hidden",
              opacity: op,
              transform: `translate(${Math.round(dx / 4) * 4}px, ${Math.round(dy / 4) * 4}px)`,
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ ...lineStyle(line), position: "absolute", left: -cx, top: -cy, width, height, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
              {line.text}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};
